用滑动基线筛出高于预期的记录。
Detect anomalies above the rolling baseline of alert_count.
test_records.MQL: db.sensors.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$alert_count", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$alert_count", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, alert_count: "$alert_count", moving_avg: 1 } }])

known_variants: db.sensors.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$alert_count", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$alert_count", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, alert_count: "$alert_count", moving_avg: 1 } }])
